:::{#exm-self-outer-product-trace}
#### The trace of a self outer product

For $\vx = (1, 2)$,
[the example of a self outer product](linear-algebra.qmd#exm-self-outer-product)
found $\soprod{\vx} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$.
Its [trace](#def-trace) and the squared [Euclidean norm](linear-algebra.qmd#def-euclidean-norm) of $\vx$ are

$$
\ba
\trf{\soprod{\vx}}
&= 1 + 4
&& \text{(definition of the trace)}
\\
&= 5
&& \text{(add)}
\\
&= 1^2 + 2^2
&& \text{(write each diagonal entry as a square)}
\\
&= \norm{\vx}^2
&& \text{(definition of the Euclidean norm, squared)}
\ea
$$

as @cor-self-outer-product-trace says.
